description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging messages with additional handling, such as chaining multiple log nodes in a linked list.
external_methods: Log.println(int priority, String tag, String msg)

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implements the LogNode interface, and allows chaining of logging nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, and optional Throwable. Passes the log message to the next LogNode if available.
